dedupe_keys.name: dmstar an r implementation of the dynamic model for stormwater treatment areas

description: Paul Julian at the Everglades Foundation publishes DMSTAr, an R implementation of the Dynamic Model for Stormwater Treatment Areas. Zenodo provides version 0.1.1 under MIT, with a public repository. The README describes deterministic hydrology and phosphorus mass balance, reproducing the behaviour of an earlier Excel/VBA model. Users can evaluate treatment-area scenarios and compare phosphorus outflow under alternative area or loading assumptions. No related catalogue record explicitly covers DMSTAr. Calibration and cited comparison cases come from South Florida, especially Everglades planning. A major limitation in the repository is that the underlying hydraulic model should not be used to design flood-control works, levees or other facilities where life or property depend on it. Transfer outside South Florida requires fresh calibration and review of assumptions. The R package was not installed, and neither legacy equivalence nor planning results were independently checked.
